# TPC-Havoc Q14_v2

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT 100.00 * SUM(CASE WHEN p_type LIKE 'PROMO%' THEN l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS promo_revenue FROM lineitem, part WHERE l_partkey = p_partkey AND l_shipdate >= CAST('1995-09-01' AS DATE) AND l_shipdate < CAST('1995-09-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' GROUP BY () HAVING SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) > 0
```
